Arman Shah: ran NebulaBoard perf/W sweep today, artifacts uploaded. need engineering + GTM to sync on kernel flag handoff and conservative marketplace wording. @Priya @Cole?
benchbot: artifacts: s3://redwood-partners/nebulaboard/2026-03-23/sweep-219.tar.gz
benchbot: headline: sustained throughput 3800 req/min, p95 33ms, perf/W 5.25 tokens/s/W (quant=int8, steady-state).
Priya Nair: marketing note: we should call it "typical system efficiency" and link to full report. legal prefers explicit test harness callout.
Cole Jensen: engineering: our mmap prefetch + PREFETCH_PAGE_ALIGN gave ~7% uplift internally. patch applies by defining ENABLE_KV_PREFETCH and calling prefetch_align before mmap.
Cole Jensen: ```
// runtime tweak
#define ENABLE_KV_PREFETCH 1
void prefetch_align(void* p, size_t sz);
```
Arman Shah: timeline suggestion:
Day 0: share patch + scripts with Nebula
Day 1-2: Nebula applies patch & runs CI
Day 3: Redwood validation + quality checks
Day 4: sign-off and marketplace asset handoff
Priya Nair: I'll draft the one-pager with conservative phrasing and sample config by EOD.
Cole Jensen: fallback plan: if partner can't enable prefetch, routing policy should bump instance size to keep p95 SLA. add to runbook.
benchbot: queued AB jobs: 9400=int8, 9401=int8-fp16 hybrid, ETA ~2h
Arman Shah: action items: Arman->share patch; Cole->provide test logs; Priya->one-pager; Nebula PM will ack off-thread. reconvene after ab jobs finish. :thumbsup:
